messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — AWS Marketplace invoice for Feb looks off. Charged to Redwood-Prod acct = $47,182 but our usage report shows $42,109. Anyone else seeing this?
Elaine Gomez: Yep, noticed this earlier this morning. AWS emitted two invoice pieces (listing + usage) and there’s a negative promotion line that didn’t flow through to the partner credit. Looks like a timing/partner-application mismatch.
Oscar Liu: I pulled the marketplace billing CSV and the Metering Report. On our side the total RAW usage before promotions = $45,900. After our negotiated reseller discount it should be $42,109. Do you have the raw AWS invoice lines?
Maya Patel: Pasting the AWS invoice summary we received from billing portal:
```
ChargeType | Amount
Marketplace usage | $45,900.00
Listing fee | $1,500.00
Marketplace promotion | -$999.00
Tax | $781.00
Total | $47,182.00
```
Maya Patel: The math is consistent with AWS total, but the partner credit we received from ChannelPartnerX is for $42,109 which matches our expected net amount *excluding* listing fee & tax. So there’s a $5,073 gap (includes listing + tax - promo).
PartnerOps Bot: New inbound invoice uploaded: s3://invoices/channelpartnerx/2026-02.pdf (attached to thread) :paperclip:
Samir Rao: Quick Q — are taxes included or passed through by partner? AWS sometimes includes VAT/MST as separate line and partners either absorb or pass-through depending on marketplace settings. Our GL expects VAT separate.
Elaine Gomez: Good point. On the partner invoice they only credit 'Marketplace usage' line, not listing fee or tax. They flagged listing fee as non-refundable in their onboarding T&C. We need to confirm whether that’s correct for ChannelPartnerX.
Oscar Liu: Action plan I suggest: 1) Reconcile meter CSV -> invoice line by line (I’ll attach my reconciliation CSV). 2) If partner omitted tax/listing incorrectly, request credit memo. 3) If partner is contractually non-refundable on listing, book $1,500 to Product Sales Expense and hold the tax to Suspense until clarified.
Maya Patel: I don't want to book anything until we hear back from partner. Elaine — can you open a partner support ticket and request an itemized credit memo covering listing fee + tax, or a contractual explanation why listing fee was excluded? Please CC procurement/legal.
Elaine Gomez: On it. Ticket created: https://partners.redwood/support/CHX-4721 — I pinged ChannelPartnerX billing and copied Legal. Asked for a response within 48 hours. :clock1:
Samir Rao: If they push back, we may need to escalate to Marketplace team (AWS) since AWS billing should reflect marketplace promotions and partner credits consistently. I can open an AWS case if needed.
Oscar Liu: If nobody replies in 48 hours, I'll prepare a journal entry template to move the $5,073 delta to a suspense account so month-end closes cleanly.
Maya Patel: Sounds good. Please add estimated GL impact in the ticket so I can get quick approval from FP&A if we end up posting the suspense entry.
Elaine Gomez: Partner replied (just now) — they say listing fee is non-refundable and tax was calculated on full invoice and cannot be credited separately per their portal. They attached their reseller agreement clause. Quoting: "Listing fees are platform fees and not refundable; tax is remitted to tax authority and outside our credit remit."
Maya Patel: Ok. Request that they provide a formal credit memo for the marketplace promotion difference ($999) and an explanation for taxes. If they refuse the listing refund, we will book the $1,500 and tax to the expense/suspense as Oscar outlined.
PartnerOps Bot: ChannelPartnerX responded with attachment: s3://invoices/channelpartnerx/response_CHX-4721.pdf
Samir Rao: Noted. I'll open an AWS Marketplace support case to verify the tax handling and whether AWS can reissue a corrected invoice if marketplace promotions weren't applied properly at settlement.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Elaine to confirm credit memo status in the ticket (48h), Samir to open AWS case if partner won’t credit tax/listing, Oscar to prepare journal entry template if we need to book delta. I’ll approve temporary suspense booking only after ticket deadline passes. :thumbsup:
Elaine Gomez: Will update CHX-4721 thread with any docs and ping Legal if partner refuses to issue credits.
Oscar Liu: Uploaded reconciliation CSV to /finance/billing/reconciliations/2026-02-aws-marketplace-recon.csv and draft JE to /finance/journal-entries/drafts/JE-2026-02-marketplace-suspense.draft.
Maya Patel: Great — closing loop once partner responds. If you need me to sign the credit memo approval, @Maya Patel available. :eyes:
